text:
- [LEXP.7.3] Any operand `Float` → result `Float`. `Int` operands promote
  automatically.

idris.name: iret_7_5__cmp_float
idris.note: An Int to the right of a Float in a comparison promotes to a Float first.

idris.name: iret_7_5__cmp_int
idris.note: An Int to the left of a Float in a comparison promotes to a Float first.

idris.name: lexp_7_3__float_op
idris.note: With a Float operand the result is a Float, computed in IEEE binary64: + - * / directly, // and % by [LEXP.7.5] / [LEXP.7.6]'s compositions.

idris.name: lexp_7_3__float_right
idris.note: An Int to the right of a Float in arithmetic promotes to a Float first; the result is a Float.

idris.name: lexp_7_3__promote
idris.note: The promotion itself: an Int to the nearest binary64, ties to even, by Idris's `cast` (Chez's exact->inexact). That the rounding is to nearest even is the runtime's and the clause's reading of [LDET.3.6.1]; run on 2^53 + 1 in Main.idr, not proved.

idris.name: lexp_7_4__div_of_ints
idris.note: `/` on two Ints with a nonzero divisor is the Float quotient of their promotions, for every such pair.

idris.name: lnul_4_1__arith
idris.note: A Float on either side of an arithmetic operator promotes the other operand; the result is a Float.
